description: Current AI auditing practices primarily focus on technical evaluations of AI models, often neglecting the socio-technical impacts that arise when these models are integrated into specific applications.

instances.assertion: Current AI auditing practices primarily focus on technical evaluations of AI models, often neglecting the socio-technical impacts that arise when these models are integrated into specific applications.
Participants in AI auditing studies advocate for integrating auditing processes across the entire development lifecycle rather than limiting them to post-hoc evaluation.
AI auditing is a systematic, independent, and documented process for evaluating AI systems against specific criteria.
